title: Test Unpublished Integration Drafts
summary: The `PostToQueueWithTriggerIdRequest` schema now includes a `workflowId` field, allowing you to target specific, even unpublished, versions of your integrations for testing.
details: Developers can now use the new `workflowId` string field within the `GoogleInternalCloudCrmEventbusV3PostToQueueWithTriggerIdRequest` schema. This enables pinning an enqueue operation to a particular workflow version, facilitating the testing of unpublished draft integrations before they are made active. This is a significant improvement for development and testing workflows.
